summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2M.2 redeployed hac-dell's canonical deployment source (/opt/pcae/runtime/src) from 305f8e7913bac76941dade6ff4e018c74533f062 (prior HMIC v1.6/36 identity, established by 149O.20L.7O.2K.2) to 4efcb255ca5340224f0278f724b939d794a553ca (the independently-verified HMIC v1.7/38 identity from 149O.20L.7O.2M.1; freshly re-derived at phase entry as HEAD == origin/main, 0 ahead/behind, clean -- not blindly reused from 2M.1's own phase-entry commit), using the exact two-transition-model mechanism frozen by 149O.20L.7M and already executed by 149O.20L.7N.4/7N.5 and 149O.20L.7O.2K.2. A fresh, narrowly-scoped CHGR (chgr-d8329c0a5874483ba6766774b8562cbb, human APPROVE plus separate CONFIRM via the governed pcae decision-session workflow, template class-b-boundary-p-provisioning-authorization v1.0) authorized exactly this transition; the existing active CertificationRecord (2e5f861249d8e70bff53ba2f371d84e37e14eff0bbfcd939902fa7b47d236bd7) and its binding were explicitly excluded from mutation. Live prechecks confirmed host identity (hostname atila-Latitude-E5470, machine-id 54ff22ce400b475aa0d55cb68f4a3334), deployed revision 305f8e79 clean/detached, and Protected Root unchanged (root:pcae, 750). Pre-mutation validator run as root (the trust-store files are root:root mode 0600, unreadable by the pcae user -- running as pcae mis-reports MALFORMED via a plain permission-denied read, not a real schema defect) returned VALID for the prior identity. One necessary, disclosed adaptation from the prior literal command form: git fetch/cat-file/checkout were run as root rather than as the pcae user, because .git/'s internal loose files are root:pcae mode 0640 (read-only for the pcae group) -- confirmed live via a Permission denied failure on the pcae-user attempt, not a chosen shortcut; running the identical commands as root succeeded and remained within the CHGR's authorized command-sequence condition. Executed fetch/verify/checkout/chown/mode-normalize scoped exactly to /opt/pcae/runtime/src. Post-deployment: 4463 tracked paths (4442x100644, 21x100755) exact match to the Mac target; zero git diff --stat HEAD drift; zero on-disk mode mismatches across a full per-tracked-file re-derivation of all 4463 entries. HMIC v1.7 (38 members including both new admin scripts, digest 3b076a639b9f1b0c55facfd1a721d59d92a377d4bb63dce920843264e873a68e, 7 contract identities) independently re-derived live on hac-dell under the deployed venv, exact match to the independent local Mac derivation. Both new admin scripts confirmed sha256 byte-identical to the Mac target; hardware admin's public --help surface is exactly {enroll, revoke}, no recover; no mutating subcommand invoked on either script. Load-bearing check: the existing active certification, re-validated (as root) against the newly-deployed source, returned IMPLEMENTATION_MISMATCH -- the expected, disclosed consequence of source evolution, not a defect -- so the HMIC readiness term is now FALSE as a pure derived consequence of certification_status_satisfies_readiness, never manually written. certifications.json/certification-bindings.json/.pcae/repository-identity.json all confirmed byte-unchanged (sha256 identical before/after); Protected Root unchanged; no HardwareCredentialRecord/Principal/Signer/DeploymentBinding/registry file created anywhere. Class-B canonical diagnostic, invoked as the deployment identity pcae with the venv activated (the correct invocation context -- invoking as root, or without the venv's console-script shim on PATH, produces spurious additional failures that are an artifact of the wrong identity/PATH, explicitly diagnosed and discarded before recording this result): NON_COMPLIANT, sole residual HBDC-REQ-042 -- the exact expected pre-first-use result. Full A/B fast_green regression classification (two complete, non-tail-truncated runs each side): baseline 333 failed/8554 passed/4 skipped/9 errors (matching 149O.20L.7O.2M.1's own recorded baseline) vs this phase's working tree 344 failed/9 errors -- exact node-ID diff shows exactly 2 newly-failing nodes, both pre-existing historical-phase working-tree-cleanliness sentinels (test_working_tree_clean_for_pcae_directory, test_no_new_chgr_published_this_phase) that assert no uncommitted .pcae/ changes exist -- the same disclosed, expected pattern already accepted by every prior CHGR-publishing phase in this lineage (2K.2, 7N.2, 2A.2-5), and one that self-resolves once this phase's own files are committed (working tree returns to clean against HEAD). Zero attributable source/logic regressions. HATP remains NOT READY / NOT ACTIVE; runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable throughout. Recommends a fresh successor phase that creates exactly one new HMIC CertificationRecord for the newly-deployed v1.7/38 identity (create-only, fresh election), leaving activation to a further separate phase.
